name: usage-meter
description: Shows context, 5-hour / 7-day limits and session tokens above the prompt, and suggests an installed skill that fits each message

plan.title: Plan label
plan.description: Text shown in the header's right corner, such as MAX PLAN. Leave empty to show none.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: auto follows light or dark mode where the surface allows it; dark is the violet console; light is the daylight one on warm paper.

skillHints.title: Skill hints
skillHints.description: After you send a message, a small model checks your installed skills and suggests one that fits. Each check uses a little of your usage.
